rationale.execution: The pipeline has multiple stages: geometry preparation, self-consistent DFT calculation, PDOS computation, and post-processing for occupancy integrals. These are sequential dependencies, using standard tools (Quantum ESPRESSO), and constitute a moderately complex orchestration.
